workflow_profile.name: scanpy_pbmc_standard
notes: Apply the active PBMC scanpy profile for preprocessing, normalization, neighborhood graph construction, and grouping.
This profile supersedes the orientation files under /root/data/reference_*.
Use the standard defaults associated with this workflow profile and keep the handoff aligned to one policy run instead of retuning an alternate grouping profile from exploratory passes.

reporting.consistency_rule: cluster summaries, annotations, and report text must describe the same grouping result
